correctness.rationale: The full orthogonal spectral decomposition gives the exact three-projector resolvent diagonal formula. Its difference formula isolates the smallest part. A graph M-matrix has nonnegative resolvent, so diagonal comparison is necessary and sufficient; an explicit scalar quadratic proves the finite/eternal threshold and endpoints. The scaled resolvent limit proves the asymptotic statement. The packaged standard-library Fraction checker completed 29662 finite exact-rational assertions. The finite tests are not used in place of the general proof.

value.rationale: This resolves the exact stochastic/positivity step size for infinitely many nonisomorphic dense multipartite diffusion networks with no singleton parts. Rather than a general method sufficient bound, the theorem gives a sharp natural two-statistic N,s invariant, identifies exactly which vertex orbits fail first, and quantifies how community size changes the allowable timestep. The closed formula is useful for reproducible discretization design, including Crank–Nicolson, and the large-N scaling is a meaningful parameter law.
